messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INCIDENT=hosted-inference-backpressure service=hosted-eu-west-1 severity=critical. Primary on-call: erin (oncall) did not ack within 2m. Secondary: tyler (sre) paged, no ACK within policy window. Manager escalation auto-fired to nadia (manager). Links: https://pagerduty.example/INC1789999001

Erin (oncall): acked (on mobile) — saw the page but phone was in DND for first ping, sorry. I'm awake and looking. :wave:

tyler (sre): I see a spike in 5xx from the inference fleet in eu-west-1, errors at 4.9% -> 12:04UTC. Routing backlog climbing, autoscaler not kicking because hosts are flapping.

kim (eng-runtime): Logs show the kv-cache eviction loop thrashing on pool hosted-eu-west-1. Example stacktrace snippet in logs: ```
[2026-03-15T12:03:45Z] runtime: panic: invalid kv-cache handle
...
```

tyler (sre): can we temporarily route traffic to fallback pool (hosted-eu-west-1-fallback)? That should stop customer impact while we patch.

kim (eng-runtime): I'm pushing a temporary routing rule now. Running: ```redwoodctl routes set --from hosted-eu-west-1 --to hosted-eu-west-1-fallback --weight 1.0 --ttl 300```

pagerduty-bot: Routing change detected by ops: initiated by kim (eng-runtime). New route will take up to 45s to stabilize. :gear:

Erin (oncall): I've acked on PD and put myself on the incident bridge. Calling in 3m.

nadia (manager): Got the escalation page. Joining bridge as manager. Quick question — do we have a customer-facing impact estimate yet?

tyler (sre): Short window so far — monitoring shows 5xx peaked for ~7 minutes, primarily affecting batch generation requests for a handful of mid-tier customers. I'd estimate ~1200 requests failed across 3 customers. No data exfiltration.

kim (eng-runtime): Patch is small — fix kv-cache handle null check and add a short backoff. I'm prepping a canary rollout: ```git checkout fix/kv-null && ./deploy canary --pool hosted-eu-west-1 --batch 2```

incident-bot: PagerDuty: automatic manager escalation occurred at +5m because secondary did not ACK within escalation window. Manager nadia (manager) notified.

Erin (oncall): I was slow to see initial page due to mobile DND; that caused the escalation chain. Apologies, will review PD notification settings after.

tyler (sre): Confirmed fallback pool absorbing traffic, error rate falling back <0.5% within 90s of route. Good.

kim (eng-runtime): Canary deploy started. Monitoring traces and logs for memory/kvcalls.

nadia (manager): Thanks team. Can we capture a short customer-impact summary for support? We should include Affected customers, windows, and whether retries succeeded.

tyler (sre): Draft for support: "Between 12:03-12:10UTC hosted-eu-west-1 experienced elevated 5xx errors affecting model generation for a subset of customers. Mitigation: traffic rerouted to fallback pool and a runtime patch deployed. Estimated failed requests: ~1200 for 3 customers. Retry/automatic fallback succeeded for most requests; support should reach out to affected accounts A, B, C to confirm any lost transactions."

Erin (oncall): Also flagging a PD action item: increase initial primary wait from 2m to 3m for this rotation and enable SMS fallback for on-call mobile DND.

kim (eng-runtime): Canary looks good for 5 minutes, promoting to full rollout now. Deploy command: ```./deploy promote canary --pool hosted-eu-west-1```

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: incident INC1789999001 acknowledged by erin (oncall) at 12:06UTC. Manager escalation remains as notification-only since incident acknowledged.

tyler (sre): Post-aggregation checks show 5xx back to baseline and tail latency stable. Will keep 15m watch.

nadia (manager): Thanks. Please add retro notes: why manager escalated (phone DND + short primary timeout), and proposed fixes (PD timeout change, SMS fallback, PD phone policy doc update).

Erin (oncall): I'll take PD policy changes. tyler take postmortem write-up for infra fix; kim write the runtime root cause section.

kim (eng-runtime): Root cause: edge case null kv-handle leading to eviction loop under pressure; fix merged and rolled out.

tyler (sre): Assigning postmortem PR to infra: https://git.example/r/pm/INC1789999001

incident-bot: Incident closed by erin (oncall) at 12:18UTC — all services normal. :white_check_mark:

nadia (manager): Good job all. Follow-ups: 1) PD timeout/sms fallback (owner: erin) 2) Add canary metric to detect kv-cache thrash (owner: kim) 3) Confirm customers notified (owner: support, cc nadia).

Erin (oncall): Noted, will open PD policy ticket and schedule a quick sync.

tyler (sre): Leaving 15m watch, will escalate if anything recurs.

kim (eng-runtime): Closing monitoring loop and adding an alert rule to detect kv-handle errors.

nadia (manager): Closing comments: minor customer-visible impact, rapid mitigation, improvement actions assigned. Thanks team.
